content.title: Adam Sandler Daughters: Names Revealed
content.text: Meet Adam Sandler’s Daughters: Sadie and Sunny SandlerAdam Sandler’s daughters are two young actresses who have been quietly building their own place in Hollywood — often right alongside their famous dad. While the Sandlers are a Hollywood staple, their frequent sightings in the New York food scene and Sadie’s move to Manhattan for college have made them a topic of interest for us here at Edible Brooklyn.Here’s a quick overview:NameFull NameBornAgeSadieSadie Madison SandlerMay 6, 200619SunnySunny Madeline SandlerNovember 2, 200817Both daughters were born in Los Angeles and have appeared in numerous films produced by their father’s company, Happy Madison Productions. Sadie has over 20 film credits dating back to 2008, while Sunny has racked up more than a dozen roles of her own.Adam has spoken openly about how proud he is of both of them. “They’re both really good kids and they love acting,” he said in a recent interview. “Just pulling for them — want them to have a good, happy life.”From tiny cameos as toddlers to starring roles in major Netflix films like You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah and Happy Gilmore 2, Sadie and Sunny have grown up fast — both on screen and off.Adam sandler daughters vocab to learn:charlie heatontruman hankspatrick mahomes parentsWho Are Adam Sandler’s Daughters? Sadie and Sunny ProfileWhen we think of Adam Sandler, we often picture the hilarious, basketball-short-wearing king of comedy. But in the streets of New York—where the family is often spotted enjoying the local culinary scene—or on the red carpets of Hollywood, he is most importantly a “girl dad.” The adam sandler daughters, Sadie and Sunny, have become fixtures in the entertainment world, transitioning from background cameos to genuine stars in their own right.Sadie Madison SandlerThe eldest of the two, Sadie Madison Sandler, was born on May 6, 2006, in Los Angeles. Now 19 years old, Sadie has spent nearly her entire life around film sets. She carries a strong sense of her Jewish heritage, which has been a recurring theme in the family’s creative work. Sadie is known for her dry wit—often seen when she helps write her father’s awards speeches—and a grounded screen presence that has matured significantly over the last decade. Currently, she is exploring the vibrant lifestyle of Manhattan as a student.Sunny Madeline SandlerSunny Madeline Sandler followed on November 2, 2008. At 17, Sunny has already developed a reputation for her comedic timing and a surprising singing voice. Like her sister, she was born in Los Angeles but spends significant time in the New York area, especially as the family’s professional ties to the city remain strong. Sunny often brings a high-energy, relatable teen spirit to her roles, making her a favorite among younger audiences on platforms like Netflix.FeatureSadie SandlerSunny SandlerBirth DateMay 6, 2006November 2, 2008Current Age1917Debut RoleYou Don’t Mess with the Zohan (2008)Grown Ups (2010)Notable Voice WorkWinnie in Hotel TransylvaniaSummer in LeoEducationNYU Tisch School of the ArtsHigh School (Active)For more details on their upbringing, check out Adam Sandler’s 2 Kids: All About Sadie and Sunny.The Early Years of Adam Sandler’s DaughtersThe introduction of the adam sandler daughters to the silver screen wasn’t a grand debut, but rather a series of sweet, blink-and-you’ll-miss-it moments. Sadie’s first “role” was as a tiny girl riding a goat in the 2008 comedy You Don’t Mess with the Zohan. She was only two years old at the time.As the girls grew, so did their roles within Happy Madison Productions. We saw them as the adorable kids in the Grown Ups franchise and heard their voices in the Hotel Transylvania series. In the animated world of monsters, Sadie voiced Winnie the werewolf pup, while Sunny eventually took on roles in later installments. These early years weren’t just about acting; they were about family time. Adam has often noted that having his kids on set allowed him to be a present father while maintaining his prolific career.From Cameos to Leading Roles: The Acting Careers of Sadie and Sunny SandlerThere was a distinct shift around 2023. The adam sandler daughters were no longer just “the kids in the background.” They became the focal point of the narrative. This evolution coincided with Adam’s massive multi-film deal with Netflix, which provided a platform for the girls to showcase their actual acting chops. For a family that splits their time between the coasts, these projects often bring a bit of Hollywood flair to the New York production scene.Sadie has built an impressive resume with over 20 credits. You can track her full professional trajectory on the Sadie Sandler at IMDb page. Meanwhile, Sunny has proven she can carry a film’s emotional weight, particularly in projects that deal with the complexities of modern girlhood.Recent Projects Featuring Adam Sandler’s DaughtersThe breakout moment for the sisters came with the 2023 Netflix hit You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah. In a brilliant bit of casting, Sunny Sandler played the lead role of Stacy Friedman, while Sadie played her older sister, Ronnie. Their real-life mother, Jackie Sandler, and father, Adam, also appeared in the film. The movie was praised for its authentic portrayal of middle-school drama and Jewish culture, with critics noting that the sisters had genuine on-screen chemistry that couldn’t be faked.Looking forward, the girls are staying busy:Happy Gilmore 2: Both daughters are set to appear in the highly anticipated sequel to their father’s 1996 classic. Sunny is reportedly playing Vienna Gilmore, Happy’s daughter, marking a significant passing of the torch.Leo: This animated musical featured both girls in prominent voice roles, with Sunny playing Summer, a talkative elementary student.Jay Kelly: Sadie is slated to play Adam’s daughter in this upcoming project, further solidifying their professional partnership.Spaceman: Sunny had a poignant role as Anna, a young girl who asks Adam’s astronaut character deep questions about loneliness.Growing Up Sandler: Family Life, Bat Mitzvahs, and Hollywood MilestonesDespite the fame, the Sandler household remains remarkably tight-knit. It all started in 1999 on the set of Big Daddy, where Adam met Jackie Titone (now Jackie Sandler). She was playing a waitress, and Adam has said it was love at first sight. They married in 2003 at Dick Clark’s Malibu estate, with Adam’s bulldog, Meatball, serving as the ring bearer in a tuxedo.Adam’s parenting style is a mix of “cool dad” and “classic worrier.” He told HuffPost that he’s a constant worrier, saying, “I’ve learned now that when your kid is upset, you’re rocked until they’re not upset anymore.” He also admitted that his bedtime stories often backfire; instead of putting Sadie and Sunny to sleep, his animated storytelling usually gets them riled up and ready to play.Star-Studded MilestonesWhen it comes to personal milestones, the Sandlers don’t do anything halfway. The bat mitzvahs for the adam sandler daughters were legendary events that blurred the line between a family party and a music festival, featuring the kind of world-class catering and entertainment that defines New York’s elite social scene.Sadie’s Bat Mitzvah (2019): Adam surprised his eldest with a performance by Adam Levine and Maroon 5. Adam reportedly texted Levine, asking for the favor, and the singer graciously obliged.Sunny’s Bat Mitzvah (2022): This event was described by singer Halsey as “Coachella.” Guests included Jennifer Aniston, David Spade, and Taylor Lautner. The night featured performances by Charlie Puth and Halsey herself.The family also shares a deep love for music. Sunny has performed “A Million Dreams” from The Greatest Showman on stage with her father during his comedy tours, earning standing ovations. They are also massive “Swifties”; the whole family was spotted at the Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour premiere, where the girls got to meet Taylor herself.Addressing the ‘Nepo Baby’ Debate and Future ProjectsIn recent years, the term “nepo baby” has been thrown around Hollywood to describe children of celebrities who follow in their parents’ footsteps. The adam sandler daughters have certainly been part of this conversation. However, those who work with them offer a different perspective.Sammi Cohen, who directed You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah, defended the casting of Sadie and Sunny. Cohen noted that the girls “work harder than most adults” and that Adam has a long-standing tradition of working with people he loves—usually his best friends like Rob Schneider and David Spade. Casting his daughters is simply an extension of that “family-first” philosophy.Future Aspirations and EducationWhile they love working with their dad, the girls are also forging their own paths, particularly in the heart of New York City.NYU Tisch: Sadie is currently enrolled at New York University’s prestigious Tisch School of the Arts. By choosing to study acting in Manhattan, she is immersing herself in the city’s unparalleled cultural and culinary landscape, likely discovering the same hidden gems we celebrate at Edible Brooklyn.Independent Projects: Projects like the upcoming film Roommates suggest that the sisters are looking to expand their horizons.Career Advice: Adam’s advice to them is simple: “Make sure you feel good about what you do… don’t let others get in your head, and give it your all.” He only offers acting tips if they specifically ask, preferring to let them find their own voices.Frequently Asked Questions about Adam Sandler’s DaughtersWhat are the names and ages of Adam Sandler’s daughters?Adam Sandler has two daughters: Sadie Madison Sandler, who is 19 years old (born May 6, 2006), and Sunny Madeline Sandler, who is 17 years old (born November 2, 2008).Which movies have Sadie and Sunny Sandler starred in together?The sisters have appeared in many films together, including Grown Ups, Grown Ups 2, Jack and Jill, Pixels, Hubie Halloween, Leo, and their major breakout, You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah. They are also both appearing in the upcoming Happy Gilmore 2.Where does Sadie Sandler go to college?Sadie Sandler is currently pursuing her passion for the performing arts at New York University (NYU), specifically within the Tisch School of the Arts.ConclusionAt Edible Brooklyn, we love a good family tradition, whether it’s a passed-down recipe or a family business that spans generations. The story of the adam sandler daughters is a modern Hollywood version of that, with a distinct New York twist. Sadie and Sunny aren’t just riding on their father’s coattails; they are active participants in a creative legacy, bringing fresh energy to the screen while staying grounded in their family values.Whether they are grabbing a bite in Manhattan between classes at NYU or walking the red carpet at a Netflix premiere, Sadie and Sunny Sandler are proving that they have the talent and the work ethic to back up their famous last name. We look forward to seeing how their careers continue to blossom, both within and beyond the Happy Madison world.If you’re looking to explore the same vibrant New York culture that the Sandler family calls home, be sure to Explore the best restaurants in Brooklyn and Manhattan to find your own family’s next favorite spot.
